{{Top}}
'''Blue Seven''' was the call sign of the seventh member of [[Blue Squadron]]. There were a number of starfighter squadrons with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Seven.

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] pilot [[Palso Thern/Legends|Palso Thern]] flew as Blue Seven during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TVC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (2 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tvcexbattleoverendor2.asp}}</ref>
